items.text: The Disneyland theme park opened in Anaheim, California, on July 17, 1955, and the opening was broadcast on the ABC television network.
items.question: Where were you when Disneyland opened, and who was the first person you knew to go there?
items.source_quote: July 17: Disneyland opens July 17 The Disneyland theme park opens in Anaheim, California, an event broadcast on the ABC television network.

items.text: The Brooklyn Dodgers won the World Series on October 4, 1955, defeating the New York Yankees in Game 7.
items.question: Who in your family followed the Dodgers or the Yankees in the 1955 World Series, and where did you hear how Game 7 ended?
items.source_quote: October 4 – The Brooklyn Dodgers win the World Series in baseball, defeating the New York Yankees 2–0 in Game 7 of the 1955 Fall Classic.
